g.text: Make some exam
questions about
photosynthesis.
• Which level? Recall?
• Distractors nobody picks
• "All of the above"
• No key, or a wrong one
• Last year's questions
reworded
Goal: 10 multiple-choice questions on
photosynthesis for a first-year biology exam
that test understanding, not recall.
Context: the learning outcomes are in
outcomes.md. Use exam-2025.pdf (public) for style
and level. Students often confuse the light and
dark reactions: use that for distractors.
Constraints: 4 options, exactly one correct;
no "all/none of the above"; do not reuse questions
from exam-2025.pdf. English. Write questions.md only.
Done when: each question names the outcome it
tests; no outcome is tested more than twice; an
answer key gives one sentence of reasoning per
question. I will solve them myself and compare.
Start in plan mode: list the outcomes you will cover.
